test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following words can be formed using the letters of the word only once?

BIODIVERSITY

Word I: DEORBITS

Word II: STEROID

Word III: VISITER

options.text: Only word I can be formed using the letters only once
Only word I and II can be formed using the letters only once
Only words I and III can be formed using the letters only once
All the words can be formed using the letters only once.

solution:
Given word: BIODIVERSITY

Word I: DEORBITS → Can be formed

Word II: STEROID → Can be formed

Word III: VISITER → Can be formed

All the words can be formed using the letters only once.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
